vm.scope_note: Development scope; no J18 clause is supported. ukai-jail run --vm, built from source (no macOS ukai-jail client ships; the DMG carries only ukai-vm and ukai-vm-install), is wired to the warm ukai-vm service but refuses at probing until a live phase re-measures the guest: the probe answers Available only for a requirement a measured guest record backs, and every other requirement answers vm:not-measured:<requirement>, network_none included (its 2026-11-02 TCP probe was vacuous). The guest jail carries only the profile (tool or agent), the wall (1-300 s), the argv, the network shape (tool none; agent proxy with the canonical allow set) and vault-mode credentials; any other policy element that differs refuses with vm:not-carried:<field> before any connection or boot, staged credential modes (copy_rw/bind_ro) included. K108.1-K113.1 stay unsupported: the 2026-11-02/03 development measurements on the dev Mac (docs/benchmarks/jail/results/macos-vm-installed-2026-11-03/ and macos-vm-claude-2026-11-03/) used a repository-built client, vacuous network probes, half the K110 matrix, a stored receipt that contradicted the guest receipt (K111) and one Claude Code attempt against J18 section 9.4's Linux-row conditions (K113). version is the public cold-boot preview the installer pins; candidate_version is the warm-service package that package.py builds, Developer-ID-signed and snapshot-pinned but not notarized and not published. A release claim needs a shipped client, the live re-measurement, and the full K108-K113 rows rerun on the notarized candidate.
